# A ball down a slope

<!-- STEP id="slope" -->
A ball rolls down a straight inclined track from O through A, B and C to D. The gaps are 40 cm, 10 cm, 20 cm and 30 cm. The track is tilted, but it is still a straight line, so we can draw it as a line starting at O.

<!-- STEP id="equal" -->
The ball never turns back. At A, B, C and D, the distance travelled and the displacement from O are equal: 40, 50, 70 and 100 cm.
